title: stare.pub index report history, format 1
description: idx.stare.pub/reports/index.json: one entry per published index build, oldest first, each with its report's totals. codexpublicus/stare-builder's `mise run index-publish` adds or replaces the published version's entry before it writes the root manifest.json. The stare.pub /data page charts it.

license.description: The licence the history is published under, the one its newest report states: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 with stare.pub as the source. Absent from histories written before it was added.

report.description: The report's path under idx.stare.pub: v/<version>/report.json.
